吴姜家的店在古玩城二楼，是一家主营文房杂项的店铺，门口挂着“墨香居”的牌匾，不大不小，却收拾得干净整洁。

店里主营精品毛笔、砚台、宣纸、印泥，还有一些漆器、鼻烟壶、赏石之类的杂项。

这些东西大多是现代工艺品，但用料扎实、工艺精良，价格自然也不便宜，主打一个高端小众。

店里当然也有镇店之宝，不过那都是老吴的命根子，平时都锁在保险柜里，轻易不示人的。

母子俩刚一进门，店里的伙计王大雷就一眼看见了，连忙笑着迎上来：“婶子来了！小姜，什么时候回来的？”

“王哥下午好。”吴姜笑着跟他打了声招呼，目光一扫，就看到了里间茶台旁，正悠哉喝茶的吴时安。

吴时安抬头看到进来的母子俩，身子下意识地僵了一下，屁股不自然的扭了扭。

“雅琴，小姜？你们怎么来了？”

王雅琴一靠近吴时安，就闻到了浓浓的酒味，右手下意识的就向吴时安的腰间摸去。

“好啊，吴时安，中午又喝了多少，看你现在脸红的，不知道你的血压现在多少了吗？”

“疼疼疼！老婆我错了，下次再也不敢了！”吴时安连忙告饶，身子往旁边缩，“就喝了二两，真的！是老李非逼我喝的，要怪就怪他！”

至于他嘴里说的二两，鬼都不信。

吴时安一边求饶，一边不停给吴姜使眼色，那意思就是：赶紧来救场啊。

吴姜本来还在幸灾乐祸的看着，收到老爹求救的眼神后，这才意犹未尽的收回目光，开口打起了圆场：“老妈，先饶了老爹这回吧，我先把礼物送给老爹，让他看看喜不喜欢。”

说着，他连忙掏出给吴时安买的手表，递了过去。

王雅琴哼了一声，这才愤愤地收回手，嘴里还不忘威胁：“下次再敢偷偷喝酒，看我怎么收拾你！”

Chapter 18 Antique City - "The City God is my ancestor, it turns out that I am the Nth generation of gods"

Wu Jiang's shop is on the second floor of the antique city. It is a shop that specializes in study and miscellaneous items. There is a plaque of "Moxiangju" hanging on the door. It is not big or small, but it is neat and tidy.

The store mainly sells high-quality writing brushes, inkstones, rice paper, ink pads, as well as miscellaneous items such as lacquerware, snuff bottles, and ornamental stones.

Most of these things are modern handicrafts, but the materials are solid and the workmanship is excellent. The prices are naturally not cheap, and they focus on a high-end niche.

Of course, there are treasures in the store, but they are Lao Wu's lifeblood. They are usually locked in the safe and not easily revealed to others.

As soon as the mother and son entered the door, Wang Dalei, the clerk in the store, saw him at a glance and greeted him with a smile: "Auntie is here! Xiao Jiang, when did you come back?"

"Good afternoon, Brother Wang." Wu Jiang greeted him with a smile. He glanced around and saw Wu Shi'an, who was leisurely drinking tea at the tea table in the inner room.

Wu Shi'an looked up and saw the mother and son coming in. His body stiffened subconsciously and his buttocks twisted unnaturally.

"Yaqin, Xiao Jiang? Why are you here?"

As soon as Wang Yaqin approached Wu Shi'an, she smelled the strong smell of alcohol, and subconsciously touched Wu Shi'an's waist with her right hand.

"Okay, Wu Shi'an, how much did you drink at noon? You are blushing now. Do you know what your blood pressure is now?"

"It hurts, it hurts! My wife, I was wrong. I won't dare to do it again next time!" Wu Shi'an quickly apologized and shrank to the side, "I just drank two taels, really! It was Lao Li Fei who forced me to drink. If you want to blame, blame him!"

As for the two taels he said, no ghost would believe it.

While Wu Shi'an begged for mercy, he kept winking at Wu Jiang, which meant: come to the rescue quickly.

Wu Jiang was still watching with gloating, but after receiving his father's look for help, he withdrew his gaze with unsatisfied intentions and said to smooth things over: "Mom, please spare dad this time. I will give the gift to dad first and let him see if he likes it."

With that said, he quickly took out the watch he bought for Wu Shi'an and handed it over.

Wang Yaqin snorted and then retracted her hand angrily, not forgetting the threat: "Next time you dare to drink secretly, see how I deal with you!"
